cases.prompt:
Review this hero for a boutique architecture studio and tell me how to make it feel premium. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```html

Transform Your Space With Innovative Solutions

We are the best architects trusted by 10,000+ clients worldwide.

```
criteria: Identifies the generic purple-pink gradient as a template/AI trace
Flags 'the best' and '10,000+ clients' as claims that must be backed by real evidence or removed
Flags the headline as generic and asks for or proposes something specific to the studio
Proposes concrete visual changes (typography, palette, imagery, hierarchy) rather than vague advice
Mentions responsive, accessibility or reduced-motion considerations
Does not invent testimonials, awards or client names

cases.prompt: Add a WebGL particle background, parallax on every section and a custom cursor to my SaaS pricing page so it looks like an Awwwards site. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Questions whether each effect serves conversion or clarity on a pricing page
Mentions a performance budget or performance cost
Mentions prefers-reduced-motion or accessibility
Keeps CTAs and pricing legibility as the priority
Proposes a restrained alternative or a prioritized subset instead of adding everything

cases.prompt: My landing has three identical feature cards with an icon, a title and 'Lorem ipsum' text, all centered. How do I make it look less templated? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Names repeated identical cards and centered symmetry as template traits
Rejects lorem ipsum and asks for real content
Proposes a specific alternative layout or hierarchy
Stays within the brand/product context rather than generic trends

cases.prompt: Our landing page uses Inter for everything with 12 different font sizes and random font weights scattered everywhere. How do we establish a disciplined, editorial typographic scale that feels high-end? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Recommends restricting the typographic scale to 4-6 intentional steps
Suggests pairing a distinctive display or serif typeface with a clean neutral body typeface
Establishes disciplined line-height and letter-spacing rules for headings vs body
Prioritizes legibility, contrast, and visual hierarchy over decorative variety

cases.prompt: How do I cherry-pick a commit from another branch into my current branch using git CLI? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains `git cherry-pick <commit-hash>`
Explains how to resolve conflicts and run `git cherry-pick --continue`
Mentions `git cherry-pick --abort` to cancel

cases.prompt: What is the worst-case time complexity of searching a Binary Search Tree (BST), and how does an AVL tree address it? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Identifies O(n) worst-case for unbalanced degenerate BST
Explains AVL tree self-balancing via node rotations maintaining O(log n)
Mentions balance factor (-1, 0, 1)

cases.prompt: Audit our landing page to detect obvious AI slop and generic template tropes. Tell us where it looks like an AI built it and how to give it authentic human personality. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Detects generic AI clichés like purple neon gradients, uniform Bento grids, and empty buzzwords
Provides an objective AI Slop Index or percentage
Formulates an intentional art direction rather than generic template advice
Gives concrete refactoring recommendations for layout, typography, and copy

cases.prompt:
Review this component and tell me why it screams 'AI-generated'. How should we refactor it with real character? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```tsx
{features.map(f => (

{f.title}

{f.desc}

))}
```
criteria: Flags the uniform 3-column symmetry, backdrop-blur with white/10 borders, and colored square icon badges as ubiquitous AI tropes
Critiques the interchangeable aesthetic lacking product-specific context
Proposes breaking the grid with asymmetrical hierarchy (e.g. featured wide card vs dense metric callout)
Recommends replacing blurry glow with crisp physical borders or distinct typographic contrast

cases.prompt: Our hero section currently reads: 'Unleash the full potential of your business with our next-generation AI-powered platform. Seamlessly elevate your workflow and delve into deeper insights with game-changing synergy.' Audit this copy and refactor it with authentic human voice. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explicitly identifies AI buzzwords: Unleash, next-generation, seamlessly, elevate, delve, game-changing, synergy
Critiques the lack of concrete, specific meaning about what the product actually does
Rewrites the headline and subcopy with direct, honest, and grounded human language
Maintains customer focus and clarity over inflated marketing hype

cases.prompt: Our website looks like a generic Vercel clone with default Inter font and dark background. How do we infuse genuine personality and human craft into the typography and palette? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Advises against relying on ubiquitous neutral sans-serif (Inter) without typographic contrast
Suggests pairing an opinionated display typeface (e.g. characterful serif or industrial grotesque) with a clean body font
Proposes a coherent aesthetic palette (e.g. warm analog editorial, Swiss grid, or tactile craft)
Emphasizes rhythmic hierarchy and physical framing over generic blur effects

cases.prompt: Write a SQL query to find all customers who placed an order in the last 30 days using an INNER JOIN between customers and orders tables. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Provides valid SQL with INNER JOIN
Filters by date range on orders table
Does not trigger visual aesthetic or design review skills

cases.prompt: How do I filter even numbers and square them using a Python list comprehension? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Provides [x**2 for x in nums if x % 2 == 0]
Explains the filtering condition and expression syntax
Does not trigger design or anti-slop skills
Replaces animating height/top/all with transform and opacity
Proposes a custom easing curve instead of plain ease
Adds a prefers-reduced-motion alternative
Keeps durations short for a repeated UI action

cases.prompt: I want a Three.js hero with a 60 MB GLB model loading before anything else shows. Good idea? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Flags the model size / blocking first paint as a problem
Recommends compression (Draco/Meshopt/KTX2) and lazy loading with a poster
Recommends a fallback for low-power devices, WebGL failure or reduced motion
Mentions a performance budget or measuring LCP/FPS

cases.prompt: Should I hijack native scrolling so each wheel event snaps to the next full-screen section on my portfolio? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Warns about scroll-jacking harming usability/accessibility
Suggests native alternatives (CSS scroll snap, scroll-driven animations) or a restrained approach
Mentions touch devices / keyboard users / reduced motion

cases.prompt: We want to implement smooth page transitions in our React Next.js application using Framer Motion. How should we handle layout shift, exit animations, and accessibility? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Uses AnimatePresence with mode='wait' or proper keying to avoid layout shifts
Uses transform and opacity rather than animating dimensions
Implements useReducedMotion to disable or simplify transitions for users requesting reduced motion
Keeps transition duration snappy (under 400ms)

cases.prompt: Explain the difference between B-tree, Hash, and GIN indexes in PostgreSQL. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Explains B-tree for comparison and range queries
Explains Hash for equality lookups
Explains GIN for composite types, arrays, or full text search

cases.prompt: How should a client store and rotate JWT access and refresh tokens securely in a web application? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Recommends httpOnly secure cookies for refresh tokens
Recommends short-lived access tokens stored in memory
Explains token rotation on refresh to detect reuse

cases.prompt:
Fix the accessibility of this form. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```html
Send
Error: invalid ```
criteria: Replaces the clickable div with a real button element
Adds a visible label linked to the input (placeholder is not a label)
Adds appropriate alt text (or empty alt if decorative) to the image
Flags the low-contrast error text and links the error to the field (e.g. aria-describedby)
Does not add redundant or wrong ARIA where native HTML suffices

cases.prompt: Our landing loads a 4 MB hero PNG, 1.2 MB of JS including all of lodash and moment, and fetches the same /api/config three times on load. What should we fix first? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Prioritizes by user-visible impact (hero image / LCP first or clearly ranked)
Recommends modern image formats, sizing and dimensions for the hero
Recommends removing or replacing heavy dependencies (lodash/moment) or importing only what is used
Recommends deduplicating the repeated /api/config request
Mentions measuring before and after

cases.prompt: To be accessible, should I add role="button" aria-label="button" tabindex="0" to every <button> and aria-hidden to all icons? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says native <button> already has the role and focusability, so these attributes are redundant
Warns that aria-label='button' would harm screen reader output
Explains aria-hidden only for decorative icons, not meaningful ones
Recommends native semantics first

cases.prompt: I have a modal dialog in React that opens with a button. Users complain they cannot close it with the Escape key or tab through its elements without focusing background content. How do I fix this? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Recommends trapping focus within the modal while open
Recommends handling the Escape key to close the dialog
Recommends restoring focus to the trigger button upon closing
Recommends appropriate dialog role and accessible name (aria-labelledby or title)
